title: Create a run
summary: Start one turn and return its result without driving the session lifecycle.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Agent id, or an object pinning a version.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The user message for this turn. Must be non-empty.

parameters.name: environment_id
parameters.description: Environment to run in. Defaults to the local environment.

parameters.name: loop_engine
parameters.description: Engine override for the created session. An unavailable engine returns loop_engine_not_supported; an unknown value returns loop_engine_invalid.

parameters.name: response_mode
parameters.description: How the answer is delivered. Defaults to wait.

parameters.name: max_wait_seconds
parameters.description: Upper bound for the wait mode, 0 to 3600. Defaults to 60.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Session fields applied at creation: title, resources, vault_ids, metadata. A file or github_repository resource on an environment whose sandbox_provider cannot serve the canonical mount roots (docker, kubernetes, self_hosted) is refused with resource_not_mountable before the session is created.

response.name: run_id
response.description: The session that ran the turn.

response.name: session_id
response.description: Same value as run_id; a run is one turn of one session.

response.name: status
response.description: completed, failed, cancelled, timed_out, cleanup_pending (200), or running, requires_action (202).

response.name: output
response.description: The agent.message content blocks produced by the turn.

response.name: usage
response.description: input_tokens and output_tokens for the session.

response.name: events_url
response.description: Where to read the durable event log (202 responses).

response.name: stream_url
response.description: Where to resume the SSE stream (202 responses).

response.name: wait_deadline_reached
response.description: Present only in wait mode when max_wait_seconds elapsed. The session keeps running.
